description: Simulated count data with an exposure offset and planted splits.
generator_code:
{
    n <- 800L
    d <- data.frame(x = runif(n), z1 = runif(n, 0, 1), z2 = factor(sample(c("g1", "g2", "g3", "g4"), 
        n, replace = TRUE)), z3 = factor(sample(c("s1", "s2", "s3", "s4", "s5"), n, replace = TRUE), 
        levels = c("s1", "s2", "s3", "s4", "s5"), ordered = TRUE), z4 = rnorm(n), exposure = runif(n, 
        0.5, 2))
    d$y_null <- rpois(n, d$exposure * exp(0.2 + 0.8 * d$x))
    high3 <- as.integer(d$z3) >= 4L
    eta <- ifelse(high3, 1.2 - 0.5 * d$x, ifelse(d$z1 <= 0.5, -0.5 + 1.5 * d$x, 0.3 + 0.3 * d$x))
    d$y_multi <- rpois(n, d$exposure * exp(eta))
    d$w <- sample(1:3, n, replace = TRUE)
    d
}
